name: Multi-Plane Image (MPI) Rendering from Point Clouds
definition: A preprocessing technique to render a 3D point cloud into a set of 2D image planes (MPI) by projecting points onto a target image grid and handling occlusion between planes.
summary: Multi-Plane Image Rendering from Point Clouds converts 3D points into discrete depth planes to enable efficient, occlusion-aware rendering without complex sorting.
